purpose: One shared source/fee/predictive-coverage diagnostic; not a trading strategy, optimization or test of any frozen model

diagnostic: Predeclared prior-completed-hour return sign versus next-completed-hour sign, require all 25 consecutive M5 closes on both sides; no threshold, no fitting, no candidate or trade
costClockRule: Use ONLY original 18 BDP1 frozen development quote clocks, select first paired causal fresh BID ASK between nominal+1s and nominal+11s; no favorable spread selection
costEvidence: Genuine old BID ASK snapshots; genuine CURRENT contract rate/floor and deposit/quote assets applied illustratively to old quote; no historical tariff/funding/execution certificate
commissionMetadata: Four ProtoOACommissionType values and minimum fee asset/type used from the original authenticated ProtoOASymbol wire; missing required wire/FX route remains unknown
hard21: Only complete financed shared-system round trips count; no diagnostic signal counts as trade
multiplicity: Report ALL SIX symbols and every chronological block; no cherry-picked asset, horizon or strategy, no promotion using globally exposed dates
dataExposure: 52 weeks are already globally research exposed. There is NO independent confirmation from these outputs.
